import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    static FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
    static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    static int N, M;
    static int[][] cap = new int[2002][2002];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] gr = new ArrayList[2002];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[2002];
    static int[] parent = new int[2002];

    static int[][] ds = {{1, 0}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}, {0, -1}};

    static int augment(int u) {
        if (u == 1) return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        vis[u] = true;

        for (int i = 0; i < gr[u].size(); i++) {
            if (!vis[gr[u].get(i)] && cap[u][gr[u].get(i)] > 0) {
                int r = augment(gr[u].get(i));
                if (r > 0) {
                    parent[gr[u].get(i)] = u;
                    return Math.min(r, cap[u][gr[u].get(i)]);
                }
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        int flow = 0;

        parent[0] = -1;
        do {
            ans += flow;

            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                vis[i] = false;
            }
            flow = augment(0);

            if (flow == 0) return ans;

            int v = 1;
            while (v != 0) {
                int u = parent[v];
                cap[u][v] -= flow;
                cap[v][u] += flow;
                v = u;
            }
        } while (flow > 0);

        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int dim, time_to_die;
        dim = fs.nextInt();
        time_to_die = fs.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < 2002; i++) {
            gr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 2002; j++) {
                cap[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        String[] labsci = new String[dim];
        String[] labcap = new String[dim];
        int[][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];
        int malfunc;

        N = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labsci[i] = fs.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labsci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labsci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    cap[0][N] = labsci[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    gr[0].add(N);
                    gr[N].add(0);
                    vert[i][j][0] = N++;
                } else if (labsci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    malfunc = 100 * i + j;
                    labsci[i] = labsci[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + labsci[i].substring(j + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        M = N;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labcap[i] = fs.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labcap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labcap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    cap[M][1] = labcap[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    gr[M].add(1);
                    vert[i][j][1] = M++;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] die = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                die[i][j] = time_to_die + 1;
            }
        }
        die[malfunc / 100][malfunc % 100] = 0;

        ArrayDeque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(malfunc);
        int x, y, nx, ny;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            x = q.poll();
            y = x % 100;
            x /= 100;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                nx = x + ds[i][0];
                ny = y + ds[i][1];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && die[nx][ny] > die[x][y] + 1) {
                    die[nx][ny] = die[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(100 * nx + ny);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] reach = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labsci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labsci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < dim; ii++) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < dim; jj++) {
                            reach[ii][jj] = time_to_die + 1;
                        }
                    }
                    reach[i][j] = 0;

                    if (labcap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labcap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        cap[vert[i][j][0]][vert[i][j][1]] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                        gr[vert[i][j][0]].add(vert[i][j][1]);
                        gr[vert[i][j][1]].add(vert[i][j][0]);
                    }

                    q.add(100 * i + j);
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        x = q.poll();
                        y = x % 100;
                        x /= 100;

                        for (int dd = 0; dd < 4; dd++) {
                            nx = x + ds[dd][0];
                            ny = y + ds[dd][1];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && reach[nx][ny] > reach[x][y] + 1) {
                                if (labcap[nx].charAt(ny) >= '1' && labcap[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9') {
                                    if (reach[x][y] + 1 <= die[nx][ny]) {
                                        cap[vert[i][j][0]][vert[nx][ny][1]] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                                        gr[vert[i][j][0]].add(vert[nx][ny][1]);
                                        gr[vert[nx][ny][1]].add(vert[i][j][0]);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reach[x][y] + 1 < die[nx][ny]) {
                                    reach[nx][ny] = reach[x][y] + 1;
                                    q.add(100 * nx + ny);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        out.println(maxflow());
        out.close();
    }
